title: Settlement Authorization for Approved Northgate Protect Claims
content:
For a claim approved on a Northgate Protect single-item plan, the settlement the administrator, Keystone Protection Services, authorizes is booked against the item's remaining share of the limit of liability. The settlement of the claim, by repair or by replacement, is booked on the plan's ledger against that claim and the covered order line, carrying the claim's type, and lowers the plan's remaining limit of liability by its value; a replacement also ends the single-item plan as fulfilled on the day it is booked.

**Registration.** The authorized repair value is fixed only after the covered item carries its limit-of-liability registration on the plan. Equivalently, while the plan's ledger shows no limit-of-liability registration for its covered item, no authorized repair value is fixed for a claim on that plan.

## Invocation: `authorize_claim_repair_5d8df043`

**Capability.** Books one settlement entry on the plan the claim belongs to, pointing back at the claim and at the covered order line and carrying the claim's type, with the method and value passed in, and lowers the plan's remaining limit of liability by that value. A replacement also ends the single-item plan as fulfilled today.

**How it is invoked.** An agent-side tool: the agent unlocks `authorize_claim_repair_5d8df043` and then calls it.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning and format |
|---|---|
| `claim_event_id` | The identifier (claim reference) of the claim being settled, as it appears on the plan's ledger |
| `settlement_method` | How the claim is settled, exactly one of the values below |
| `amount_usd` | The settlement value, US dollars as a positive decimal number with 2 decimal places; any further digits are rounded half up to the cent |

| `settlement_method` value | Effect |
|---|---|
| `repair` | The covered item is repaired at the authorized repair value |
| `replacement` | The covered item is replaced, booked at the item's remaining limit of liability, and the plan ends as fulfilled |
| `reimbursement_egift_card` | Not booked by this tool, which answers with an error |
| `food_loss_payment` | Not booked by this tool, which answers with an error |
| `not_applicable` | Not booked by this tool, which answers with an error |

**Return.** A text receipt: "Settlement authorized on claim <claim_event_id> of plan <plan_id>: <settlement_method> <settlement_ref>, value USD <amount>; remaining limit of liability now USD <remaining>; plan status <status>." with a new settlement reference, the value and new remaining limit with two decimals, and the plan's status afterwards (active, or fulfilled after a replacement). Receiving it means the settlement was booked. Errors, with nothing booked: "Error: this tool books only repair or replacement settlements." for any other method, and "Error: amount_usd must be a positive amount in US dollars." for a value that is not positive.
